## About David

David Chen is CFO of RetailFlow and the longest-serving member of the executive team at 8 years. Promoted internally, he brings deep financial knowledge and a conservative approach to investment decisions.

David has seen retailers collapse from poor financial discipline and is determined to ensure RetailFlow doesn't make the same mistakes with technology investments.

## Financial Focus

- ROI accountability on all investments
- Margin protection and cost control
- Financial risk management
- Evidence-based decision making
